summary: 30 cases (8 labeled sample sessions plus 22 variants), 3 cold runs per configuration with gpt-6-luna, Oct 12 2026. Ranges are min–max over the runs; tokens, cost and seconds are means per cold refresh. "Repeat refresh" is the same sessions again with nothing changed. The default also ran the done checker on the 6 cases with a task contract: 5–6/6 verdicts right.

configs.name: default
configs.desc: batches of 10 sessions per triage call, last 14 events each, unchanged sessions skipped

configs.name: trimmed tail
configs.desc: same, but only the last 6 events per session

configs.name: long tail
configs.desc: same, but the last 30 events per session

configs.name: one call per session
configs.desc: no batching: a triage call for every session

configs.name: no change skip
configs.desc: default, but every refresh re-reads every session (the bug that started the project)
